outline.title: Seed in the Soil
outline.logline: Noor plants a seed and tends the spot each day by patting the soil soft until a green shoot appears.
outline.theme: steady care makes a seed grow

characters.name: Noor
characters.description: A four-year-old who plants one seed in the garden and tends the spot with daily care.

beats.title: Seed in the soil
beats.summary: Noor presses a seed into the garden bed and steps back. The same short phrase 'Seed in the soil' appears here and will return changed at the end.

beats.title: Water each day
beats.summary: Noor waters the spot every morning and says the repeating line 'Water the seed' while they work.

beats.title: Pat the soil
beats.summary: Noor pats the soil soft each day after watering and repeats 'Pat the soil soft' so water and air can reach the seed.

beats.title: Worm paths
beats.summary: Noor keeps patting and notices the soft lines worms have left in the dirt around the seed.

beats.title: Green appears
beats.summary: After many days Noor pats the soil soft again and a small green shoot pushes up through the loosened earth.

beats.title: Shoot in the soil
beats.summary: Noor smiles at the shoot their care helped reveal and the book ends on the same short phrase now altered to 'Shoot in the soil'.

pages.visual_action: Noor presses one seed down into loose soil, steps back
Noor tips watering can over the same spot
Noor pours water again the next morning
Noor pats soil gently with both hands
Noor pats the same spot soft again
Noor sees thin worm lines near the seed while patting
pages.emotional_shift: notices quiet help in the dirt

pages.visual_action: small green shoot rises through patted soil
pages.page_turn_hook: What is now in the soil

pages.visual_action: Noor smiles at the green shoot

pages.text: Noor sets the seed in the bed. Down it sinks. Soil settles around it. What comes after that?
Water runs over the spot. The can tips low. Again it flows. Does it reach the seed?
Morning comes. Noor tips the can once more. Water soaks in. What follows the water?
Noor presses both hands down. The soil shifts under them. Press and lift. Does the press change anything?
Noor presses the same place again. Hands move in the same way. Press and lift. What will the soil show?
Thin lines mark the soil near the seed. Noor follows one with a finger. Press and lift. What will push through next?
A thin green tip lifts the soil. It rises where the hands pressed. Noor watches it move. What stands in the garden now?
The green tip stands where pressed. Noor rests a hand beside it. The garden holds it steady.
